title: Input movement commutes with position transport
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $x$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $p$ be one of the $|x|+2$ input-head positions. For every direction $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, transporting the position after moving the head by $d$ gives the same position as moving by $d$ after transport.
hypotheses_covered: A position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ input-head positions
replaced:
Moving the input head one step in any direction commutes with the transport of head
positions from an input word to its symbol-wise encoding.
